title: Not waterproof. Didn’t last 60 days.
text: Not waterproof. Didn’t last 60 days.. Was using as a spa timer. Fell in spa and was quickly filled with water. Unreadable display after drying out and replacing batteries.

product_metadata.title: Senicare Digital Timer for Kitchen with Loud Alarm, Shower Clock Bathroom, Waterproof Water Splashes, Small Wall LCD Screen, Temperature Humidity, Suction Cup, White
features: 【Good Helper in Life】 The timer can also be a clock. It is a great choice for daily display of time, temperature and humidity display, and countdown. It is suitable for places where time needs to be recorded, such as living room, bedroom, bedside, bathroom, kitchen, laundry room, etc.

【Multifunction Display】This LCD Clock features time, temperature, and indoor relative-humidity readings all in one easy to read screen. 12/24 hour switchable Time Display, C/F switchable Indoor Temperature Thermometer Display. Celsius and Fahrenheit range between 0°C-50°C and 32°F-122°F. Indoor Humidity Hygrometer Display range between 15%-95%.

【Time Management Tool】You can easily countdown your time with 3 quickly adjustable buttons (10min/1min/clear). Timer can measure up to 99mins. Loud but not deafening alarm can be heard clearly. Not only can it help you save time, but it is also a good tool for educating kids to manage time.

【Waterproof Touch Screen】 The digital shower clock has an IP25 waterproof rating, without fear of splashes from all directions, to ensure that no water mist or water seeps into the timer in the bathroom. The surface uses touch buttons, which are sensitive and quick to set the countdown.

【Easy to Set 】It is simple to operate this clock! Reading Manual can help you to install easily. Hole for Wall Hanging and Mounting, comes with an Adhesive Hook to help you hang it on the wall. Suction Cup only for Glass, Window, Mirror, Granite and Stainless Steel. Requires 2 "AAA" batteries (Not Included).
